forecasters.mean: Constant mean of the four acquired public spike counts, clipped at zero
forecasters.nearest: One nearest acquired public waveform by squared Euclidean distance on eight generic waveform features, scaled by pooled train-and-forecast public feature standard deviation with components below 0.05 set to 1; deterministic first-index tie break

reference_forecaster: Archived fixed ridge penalty 1.0 predictions from the original controls
metric: Official max(mean squared six-label spike forecast error minus 0.25, zero)
interpretation: Same-data forecaster sensitivity on six already-scored designed development worlds. No new independent systems, no causal inference, no tuning or method promotion from this result.
forbidden: No Azure or other closed-source model API, no upstream World object in predictor, no private target read before predictions are written
